<thought>We need to create an ML‑ready tabular dataset from the provided polymorph JSON, using advanced feature engineering, a 0.2 test split, and normalization. The tool will write the dataset and a metadata JSON file into the specified output directory (sulphide_ml_dataset). After running the tool we will list the output directory to find the exact metadata file name and then return its path.</thought>
<action>prepare_tabular_dataset</action>
<action_input>{
    "polymorphs_json_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/2_batch_retrieve_sulphide_polymorphs_trial_10/polymorph_data.json",
    "output_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/2_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_14/sulphide_ml_dataset",
    "target_property": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "feature_engineering": "advanced",
    "test_split": 0.2,
    "normalize": true
}</action_input>
